translation.entry: The wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except the Mystery Bomb, Shooting Star and bonus symbol. A payline of all wilds pays as the highest value symbol.

All symbols which are part of a win, except wild symbols in Bompers, explode and dissappear. The avalanche cycle continues as long as new winning combinations appear. Additional symbols drop at the end of the avalanche cycle, and an additional row of symbols is added at the top, up to a maximum of 8 rows.
At random during the base game up to 5 Bompers can appear. When the meter is full, the Bomper turn into a sticky wild.
When the Mystery Bomb is triggered, it turns itself and all connecting symbols into a random symbol. When 2 or more Mystery Bombs overlap, all overlapping symbols will become wild.
The Shooting Star, strives to travel upwards. When it reaches the top of the reel, it creates a mixed collection of up to 7 symbols, always guaranteeing up to 3 wilds.
3 bonus symbols trigger 7 free drops. Free drops can be retriggered.
Free drops starts with up to 5 Bompers. When the meter is full, the Bomper turn into a sticky wild and is sticky throughout the whole bonus game.
Normal symbol drop in Normal mode.
Guarantees 3 symbol drops with increasing number of Bompers. The first drop starts with 1 Bomper, and each subsequent drop adds 1 additional Bomper.
Guarantees 5 symbol drops with increasing number of Bompers. The first drop starts with 1 Bomper, and each subsequent drop adds 1 additional Bomper.
Guarantees a game round with 3 bonus symbols and entry to the bonus game.
Guarantees 10 symbol drops with increasing number of Bompers. The first drop starts with 1 Bomper, and each subsequent drop adds 1 additional Bomper.

Total bet.

1. Bompers is a 6 column, 4 rows slot with dropping symbols and up to 262 144 ways to win. The columns may expand upwards to a total of 8 rows.
2. The minimum bet is __MINBADEFBMODE__, and the maximum bet is __MAXBADEFBMODE__.
3. Each bet is __CPBB__ coins.
4. All wins begin with the leftmost reel and pay left to right only on consecutive reels. Only the highest win per active payline is paid out.
5. A game round starts on the selected bet level when the player hits the Spin button.
6. The game can be played automatically by activating Auto Spin (if available in the applicable jurisdiction). Hold down the Spin button or use the Auto Spin button to set the number of game rounds to be played automatically.
7. Winnings and winning combinations are paid out according to the paytable.
8. Winnings are presented in the player's currency or in coins. The player can change preference in Settings.
9. Bompers is played in two modes; Normal mode and Bonus mode with free drops.
10. All symbol drops in Normal mode start with 4 rows and 4 096 ways to win.
11. The wins in the current symbol drop are collected and then all symbols included in a winning combination are removed. The remaining symbols, except the Shooting Star, fall vertically, slide to the left and then right repeatedly until they reach a resting position. The new result is paid out accordingly and the avalanche cycle continues as long as new winning combinations appear.
12. When the avalanche cycle ends, the next symbol drop will add one additional row of symbols at the top, resulting in an increased number of ways to win.
13. The number of ways to win increases as the number of rows increases. 4 rows: 4 096 ways to win 5 rows: 15 625 ways to win 6 rows: 46 656 ways to win 7 rows: 117 649 ways to win 8 rows: 262 144 ways to win
14. The wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except the Mystery Bomb, the Shooting Star and the bonus symbol. A winning combination of all wilds pays as the highest value symbol.
15. When a Shooting Star appears, it will always strive to move upwards whenever there is empty space above it. If a Shooting Star reaches the top of the symbol area, it will generate a collection of up to 7 symbols including itself. The collection will always consist of a mix of payout symbols and wild symbols, and they will all fall downwards towards the symbol area.
16. The Shooting Star always generates as many symbols around itself as can fit on the screen, up to a maximum of 7 (including a replacement of itself).
17. The Mystery Bomb can be dropped in any symbol drop or be generated by a Shooting Star. It explodes and replaces itself and its connecting symbols with a randomly selected payout symbol, at the end of the avalanche cycle when there are no more wins.
18. Wild symbols, Bompers, bonus symbols and Shooting Star symbols are not replaced by the Mystery Bomb effect.
19. If 2 or more Mystery Bomb symbols explode at the same time, potential overlapping positions will be filled by wild symbols.
20. In Normal mode, up to 5 Bompers can randomly appear prior to symbols dropping in. Bompers are sticky and stay in the same positions during all wins and avalanches. Every symbol hit on a Bomper from any direction is collected in the Bomper meter, and the Bomper turns into a sticky wild when the meter is full.
21. 3 bonus symbols anywhere in view during Normal mode, trigger Bonus mode with free drops. 7 Free drops are awarded. Every new free drop starts at 4 rows.
22. At the beginning of the free drops, up to 5 Bompers appear in view. Bompers are sticky and stay in the same positions during all wins and avalanches throughout the free drops. Every symbol hit on a Bomper from any direction is collected in the Bomper meter, and the Bomper turns into a sticky wild when the meter is full.
23. The current states of the Bompers are persistent between free drops.
24. When a Mystery Bomb explodes, and there are Bompers within the Mystery Bomb expansion area, the Bomper meter will increase one level per exploded Mystery Bomb. This applies both in normal mode and bonus mode.
25. 3 bonus symbols during bonus mode retrigger additional free drops.
26. The free drops bonus game ends when no free drops remain or when the maximum win has been reached.
27. Winnings are paid out at the end of the bonus game.
28. No bets can be changed during an ongoing symbol drop in any Bonus mode.
29. The theoretical payout (RTP) in Bompers is __RTP__.
30. The game has a maximum win of __TBB__ the placed bet.
31. In the event of malfunction all bets and wins are void.
Last updated 2022-01-17
The X-iter feature offers several different game modes.
Default: Normal symbol drop in Normal mode. This is the default setting of the game.

X-iter 1: Guarantees 3 symbol drops with increasing number of Bompers at the cost of 25x the selected bet. The first symbol drop starts with 1 Bomper, and each subsequent drop adds 1 additional Bomper. The states of the Bompers are persistent between the 3 symbol drops.

X-iter 2: Guarantees 5 symbol drops with increasing number of Bompers at the cost of 50x the selected bet. The first symbol drop starts with 1 Bomper, and each subsequent drop adds 1 additional Bomper. The states of the Bompers are persistent between the 5 symbol drops.
X-iter 3: Guarantees a game round with 3 bonus symbols and entry to the bonus game at the cost of 100x the selected bet.

X-iter 4: Guarantees 10 symbol drops with increasing number of Bompers at the cost of 300x the selected bet. The first symbol drop starts with 1 Bomper, and each subsequent drop adds 1 additional Bomper. The states of the Bompers are persistent between the 10 symbol drops.
The X-iter features can only be activated in the base game.
The minimum X-iter cost is __MINBABMODE__, and the maximum cost is __MAXBABMODE__.
The theoretical payout (RTP) for all X-iter game modes in Bompers is __RTP__.
All game rules apply for the X-iter features as well.
